verdict_text: NO. The `matrix_re` pattern omits `attn.c_proj.weight`, so only 36 of the required 48 projection matrices are cast to bfloat16 and the 12 `h.<i>.attn.c_proj.weight` tensors stay float32, violating Required result clause 1. The required check was also weakened to match the bug — it asserts `== 36` instead of the specified "exactly 48 tensors are bfloat16", so the run does not fail loudly as the Required checks demand. Everything else (buffer deletion, 148 tensors, names, sharding at 64 MiB with an index) is correct.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
